name: Defect Quote
office_task: When a tech logs fire or life-safety defects on a site's inspection or fault job, draft one rectification quote on it from our own price list, or park it, and leave it for us to send.
systems_of_record: Xero (Items as the rectification price list, Quotes)

emits.write: One draft rectification quote on the inspection or fault job the defects were logged on, one line per open defect, each line carrying the catalogue id and rate read from the price list at draft time (ex GST), the defect id and the asset id it rectifies. It is left in draft for the person who owns defect quotes to send to the site's owner or managing agent; this node has no way to send it.
emits.readback: The quote is read back by the id the system returned (Simpro GET /api/v1.0/companies/{companyID}/quotes/{quoteID}, ServiceM8 GET /api_1.0/jobquote/{uuid}.json, Xero GET /api.xro/2.0/Quotes/{QuoteID}) and must carry the job id. No id back is not a write: it raises quote.write_failed.

emits.write: A parked rectification quote as an exception on the job: the park reason from the standard's fixed list, the defects that did price with their catalogue ids, the defects that did not with their defect and asset ids, no total, and exception_owner set to the person the business named for defect quotes.
emits.readback: The exception desk returns an exception_id; reading the job by its id shows the open exception with its exception_owner, and the next hop reads it there and stops.
